reply.text: This is a pain-adjacent message: "knees feel beat up" is a symptom report, so I can't assess it. But the request to replace leg extensions is a program change I can make, and I can do it without diagnosing anything. I'll make the swap and tell him it's one for a doctor or physio if it's more than a training question. I'll put leg extensions over to hamstring curls for you to confirm in the app. That's a training swap, not a read on your knees. If they feel beat up beyond normal training soreness, or they hurt, that one's for a doctor or physio, not me. Tell me when you want to keep going on the training side.
